_comment: Pure immersion flavor (Small-town Americana). NO mechanical impact — it only drives the header banner, the season announcements, and the year-end award ceremony. The current season is derived from turn / max_turns (4 seasons across the fiscal year), so it scales if you retune the year length. Rename the town/bureau/award freely.

season_intros.Spring: 🌱 Spring on Main Street — a fresh fiscal year opens in Maple Hollow.
season_intros.Summer: ☀️ Summer — the busy season; everyone's books are open at the BBB.
season_intros.Fall: 🍂 Fall — collections tighten and the standings start to matter.
season_intros.Winter: ❄️ Winter sets in — the Business of the Year gala is around the corner.
